verdict.left_looks: A tall, thick, slightly tapering square tower in light gray with broad red bands. It has a cobblestone and mossy base with a stone-brick plinth, a few dressed stone window and door surrounds, and a wooden door. The top has a stone-brick gallery with fence posts, a glass and dark-wood lantern, and a dark roof. A small annex with a brick roof, timber framing, pink-terracotta walls and a cobble chimney with a lantern sits against the tower. The view is cropped close, so the tower dominates. Some silhouette skew and a ragged shading edge are visible.
verdict.right_looks: A slender, tapering lighthouse with red and white bands, an octagon-like stepped profile, and a stone base. The gallery is wide, with a railing, a glazed lantern room with a visible lamp, and a red cap with a finial. A separate cottage with a dark timber gable roof, a chimney, gray walls and a small stone foundation sits beside it. The whole thing is on a grass island plot with sand and water. The cottage's gable end looks stepped and rough, with the roof beams jutting out. The tower has few openings, and the windows are small.
verdict.why: Left has richer material texture (mossy cobble base, dressed stone window surrounds, brick-roofed timber annex with chimney) and a more integrated tower-plus-annex composition, while Right has a better lantern and silhouette but plainer, flatter walls and a rougher stepped gable on the cottage.
